summary: # CLO 2025.2 New Features Highlight Video: Shining Launch, Innovative Again! ## Introduction Let's take a quick look at the latest features of CLO 2025.2. ## New Paper Editor and Needle Design Function First, we developed a new piece of paper editor and expanded CLO's needle design function. - **Selecting Wool Product**: Select the wool product and then click the wool ball icon next to the needle. - **Designing the Piece of Paper**: Here, you will be able to accurately design the piece of paper. Adjust the density of the piece of paper and the thickness of the gusset, and apply different types of needles. - **Simulation and Style Preview**: After applying different needles, you can simulate and apply it to the costume. You can preview the style effect after applying the different needles. ## Expanded Types for the Piece of Paper We have added more types for the piece of paper, making it easier to create pants and shorts. ### Pants Options For pants, we have two options: - **Gold Waist Pants** - **Leisure Pants** You can create a piece of paper by entering a simple measurement value, as shown here. - **Detailed Information Setup**: Now select the leisure pants. You can switch to setting detailed information, allowing you to enter more details to increase control and accuracy. ### AI Version Generator You can also use the AI version generator to create pants and shorts. For shorts, you can choose between: - **Round Shorts** - **A-shaped Shorts** - **Text Prompt**: Enter the text prompt to create an image, then use the image to create your version. Alternatively, you can upload a style image and generate the corresponding version. ## GPU Simulation Now you can use the GPU to simulate a software model. Compared to before, the test version is faster and more accurate for editing costumes. - **Body Change Check**: Open the software model simulation and use GPU simulation to check body changes. ## Updated Cutout Size We have updated the cutout size to make it more accurate. - **Cutout Position Control**: Now when you open the cutout, you can check all the cutouts on the size of the cutout. You can control the cutout position of each size and change the direction of the cutout size and the fixed size. ## Pattern Creation Now it's easier for you to create a repeat pattern. We have updated the editor to allow you to quickly and easily flip the image horizontally and vertically at the same time. ## Sticker Attribute Editor Enhancements We have updated the 2D position measurement in the sticker attribute editor. - **Exact Positioning**: It allows you to move the sticker by entering the exact position value, putting your sticker in the precise position you want. ## Symmetrical Zipper Creation Now you just need to right-click on the zipper and select the version that is copied to the symmetrical modification to easily create a symmetrical zipper. However, the zippers on both sides are not linked, allowing you to edit the zipper on either side. ## Cutout Window Adjustment We heard that many users hoped to stop the new cutout window on the left side. Now you can click on this arrow to move the cutout back to its original position. After this update, the cutout will be removed. ## Integration with MetaHuman Now you can easily use MetaHuman in the cutout design. - **DNA File Format**: Use the DNA file format to import different bodies and heads, ensuring compatibility with Unreal Engine and other platforms. - **Exporting to MetaHuman Creator**: Once you have completed the design in the cutout, you can export all the content back to MetaHuman Creator. Your clothing will automatically adjust the size to adapt to any changes you make to the MetaHuman body, making it easier to use MetaHuman than before. ## Customization Features You can also change the size of your clothes to facilitate use with MetaHuman and create realistic rendering images. - **Hat Customization**: We are very happy to announce that in this version, we will expand the customized configuration function to the hat category. You only need to select the corresponding version or OBJ file, then register it as a hat. After registration, you can add this hat to any of your projects. - **Design Configuration in the Cutout**: We have also updated the design configuration in the cutout, expanding it to the customized copper model. You can change the colors here, including hair, glasses, eyebrows, underwear, skin, etc. ## Animation Improvements We have added some functions to improve the user experience in the animation. - **Layer Creation**: Now you just need to click a button to create layers for all objects, and you can also add layers to your project. - **Keyframe Operations**: We also added the option of shape optimization, plate shrinkage, and pressure. This update simplifies the operation of adding keyframes, allowing you to add multiple keyframes at a time and choose to apply the keyframe to all layers or select a layer. ## Conclusion Thank you very much for watching! I wish you a pleasant creation in the hole.
